Alderaan Trade Alliance.|The crew member|audio=PitCrew-Alderaan.flac|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] served as a '''pit crew member''' on board an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser]] [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by [[Captain]] [[Elk]] as part of the [[Segra-Milo Imperial patrol]]. In [[5 BBY]], the [[cruiser]] encountered the [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]] of the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]], who provided a false [[Transponder code|transponder ID]] that Elk had the crew member check. The crew member eventually reported back that the ID cleared, but Elk ordered that the [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]] be boarded anyway. Rael then activated his [[engine]]s, so Elk had the crew member increase the power of the cruiser's [[tractor beam]]; however, Rael destroyed the Imperial vessel's forward tractor dish and caused the beam to fail. The rebel then escaped from the Imperials. ==Biography== {{Quote|How long on the ID?''"
"''In the queue, sir.|Captain Elk and the pit crew member|audio=Elk-ID.flac|}} [[File:ArrestorCrewPit.png|thumb|right|300px|The crew member served on board a ''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser.]] During the [[Imperial Era]], a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] served as a part of the pit crew on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of a [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Segra-Milo Imperial patrol]]. The [[cruiser]] was [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by [[Captain]] [[Elk]] and tasked with patrolling the [[Realspace|space]] around the [[planet]]{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} {{AD|Disney+}} [[Segra Milo]], a [[Pirate|piracy]] zone where [[Partisans]] activity had been reported. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|111}} the cruiser encountered a [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]] above Segra Milo. Elk contacted the cruiser's [[pilot]], the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]], and requested a [[Transponder code|transponder ID]]. Rael stalled and then provided a false ID found by his [[Fondor Droid Mod]], which Elk had the pit crew member run through the system. Elk continued to converse with Rael as they waited for the crew member, ordering the cruiser's [[tractor beam]] activated to hold the vessel and then having a boarding team prepared. When the crew member reported that the transponder ID had cleared as belonging to a [[starship]] from the [[Alderaan Trade Alliance]], Elk did not have the boarding party stand down, claiming they could use the practice. [[File:ArrestorPitCrew1Bridge.png|thumb|left|300px|The pit crew member served under Captain Elk.]] Once Elk informed Rael that he was to be boarded, the rebel activated his [[Engine|thrusters]] fully, beginning to pull away from the cruiser. On Elk's orders the crew member increased the tractor beam by five, but Rael then activated countermeasures that launched shrapnel back into the cruiser's forward tractor dish, shredding it. The crew member informed Elk that the tractor beam was failing, prompting the captain to snap back at his subordinate for the obvious remark. Elk then had an air [[Wing (formation)|wing]] launched, but Rael destroyed it and escaped the Imperials. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Tractor beacon is failing us.''"
"''I can see that. Where's my air wing?|The pit crew member and Captain Elk|audio=Elk-AirWing.flac|}} The pit crew member had dark skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]]. ==Equipment== The pit crew member wore a black [[Imperial military uniforms|uniform]] with a black [[Imperial Navy Trooper]] [[helmet]]. ==Behind the scenes== The pit crew member, credited only as "Pit #1," was portrayed by [[Victor Ali]] in the television show ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', appearing in the [[Andor Season 1|first season's]] eleventh episode, "[[Daughter of Ferrix]]," which aired on [[November 16]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified male pit crew member|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified male pit crew member}} *{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|YegFD5FT3mo|Andor | Luthen's Escape | Disney+}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ორმოს გუნდის უცნობი წევრი მამაკაცი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy personnel of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
